facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports Mauritania launched its national cloud on 29 June 2026 at the Nouakchott National Data Centre to host public administration data and digital services on national territory.
Agence Ecofin reports the ministry did not give a migration timetable for administrations' applications and databases to the new national cloud.

systems.platform: Nouakchott National Data Center (Tier III, WARDIP)
